resources.string: Play a track to use the equalizer.
Tunes every song to its own genre, then refines it by listening to the track itself. Takes over the equalizer while it\'s on; your manual curve comes back when you turn it off.
Set for this song. Turn the automatic equalizer off in Settings to adjust the bands yourself.
